capabilities: Autocomplete code symbol references via a trigger and insert markdown deep links
Open links at the exact line in VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, file://, or GitHub/GitLab permalinks
Embed code snippets inline with fenced code-link blocks and hover previews
Pin links to symbols, kinds or lines and repair drifted links after refactors
Index code repositories on disk with custom language definitions
disambiguation: It links notes to source files outside the vault; it does not run, format or lint code inside notes.
extras: Desktop-only: it reads repositories through Node's filesystem API, which isn't available on mobile. Beta builds are available via BRAT. On Linux, index auto-refresh falls back to per-directory watching and can hit the OS watch limit on very large trees. A custom languages file is run as-is with no safety validation, which the README flags.
motivation: It is written as the source-code counterpart to the author's Reference Linker, which does the same for PDFs and Office documents outside the vault.
problem: Notes can't deep-link to a specific symbol or line in a codebase outside the vault, and links break when the code moves.

relations.evidence: It's the source-code counterpart to Reference Linker, which does the same for PDFs and Office documents

requires.name: VS Code, JetBrains IDE or another editor

summary: Autocompletes references to source-code symbols and inserts deep links that open the exact line in an IDE or on GitHub/GitLab, or embed live code snippets.
